{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot true prices at inflection points, especially when moving away from historical mean.",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.33) accelerates price recovery from lows, creating lag in model recovery to true values.",
    "When prices are at or near 18-day low, model forecasts remain too high by 0.3-0.8 compared to true bottom prices.",
    "Sentiment turning negative ( <0) causes immediate price stabilization at lows while model continues undershooting.",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes overshoot when prices are at extremes, especially with opposing sentiment",
    "Correcting the forecast at each sentiment regime change eliminates 80% of systematic forecast error",
    "Model fails to capture price velocity changes at sentiment inflection points, causing persistent lag"
] }
